exposure: moved away from commune of birth
primary person to confide in (other than husband)
cohort: The study included 823 pregnant women in Thai Binh, Vietnam, who were screened for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).
finding: Lack of social support, moving away from the commune of birth, and confiding primarily in someone other than the husband were significantly associated with increased odds of depression symptoms among pregnant women, regardless of GDM status.
